description: Elections Commission - Declare that Ranhaluge Krishani Fernando as a member of the Moratuwa Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Moratuwa Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a municipal council seat, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7), which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
